parts.t: Willoughby Heights, covered by the Township’s Willoughby Community Plan, is a large urban community on the western edge of the Township of Langley. It has grown almost tenfold since 2011, and the Township adopted an updated community plan in June 2026. New schools, parks and transit are still coming, so what is planned near a home matters as much as the home.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 8, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the Township of Langley.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

The Willoughby Community Plan was updated in 2026, so older neighbourhood plans may no longer apply.
On June 15, 2026, Council adopted the updated Willoughby Community Plan (Bylaw 6201), the Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan (6202) and the Gordon Neighbourhood Plan (6203).
The update repealed the Carvolth, Jericho, Latimer, Routley and three Gordon Estate neighbourhood plans. Applications made before June 15, 2026 can proceed under the old plans until June 15, 2028.
The Yorkson, Smith and Williams neighbourhood plans were completed in December 2025.
TransLink’s proposed bus rapid transit on 200 Street was a key driver of the update.

Willoughby Heights is on the western edge of the Township of Langley, bounded by Surrey, Highway 1, 68 Avenue and the Trans Mountain right-of-way, and 216 Street and the Willowbrook Connector.
Are Willoughby Heights school catchments changing?
Yes. New Willoughby Slope catchments take effect in September 2027, when two new Smith-area schools open. SD35 says nearly all Willoughby Slope schools are at capacity.
Which schools are in Willoughby Heights?

Elementary schools include Willoughby, Lynn Fripps, Richard Bulpitt, Donna Gabriel Robins and Josette Dandurand, plus Yorkson Creek Middle, Peter Ewart Middle and R.E. Mountain Secondary. Check the SD35 School Locator for the exact address.
Is SkyTrain coming to Willoughby Heights?
Willowbrook Station, at 196 Street and Fraser Highway, is planned on the Surrey Langley SkyTrain line, with a current anticipated in-service date of late 2029.
What changed in the 2026 Willoughby Community Plan?
Council adopted an updated Willoughby Community Plan on June 15, 2026, with a transit corridor plan and a Gordon neighbourhood plan, and repealed several older neighbourhood plans.
What is at Willoughby Community Park?
The Willoughby Community Centre, Langley Tennis Centre, four lighted synthetic fields, an amphitheatre, a playground, a spray park and courts.
Is there a library in Willoughby Heights?
The Township lists Muriel Arnason Library, at 130-20338 65 Avenue, for Willoughby and Willowbrook.
